'''Ivexia''' was an astronomical object<ref name="TROS VD" /> that was located in the [[Ivexia system]] in the [[Tennuutta sector]] of the [[Mid Rim Territories]].<ref name="Galaxy Map" /> It was the site of the [[Mirror-Spires]] of Ivexia.<ref name="TROS VD" />
